name: 13210 · Syracuse, NY
findings: ZIP 13210 (Syracuse) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 63 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13210 (Syracuse) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
